feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 11:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 28 May 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later today.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in sea area German Bight, slowly transferring eastwards. Large slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5 briefly decreasing 3 or 4 this afternoon, veering south or southwest 5 or 6 late afternoon and this evening. Decreasing southwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming mainly moderate this evening, then slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but areas of mist and coastal fog patches developing from the south later this afternoon and evening, clearing overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor in mist and very poor in any fog patches late today & early tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4, backing south or southwest later, 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in south.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon falling mainly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
